# Purus CSS

Purus CSS is a class-light, HTML-first CSS foundation. Prefer semantic HTML and native elements before adding classes.

Supported classes: container, prose, stack, cluster, grid, sidebar, card, button, badge, callout, visually-hidden.

Supported themes: data-theme="light" and data-theme="dark"; no attribute follows the system preference.

Use semantic tokens documented at https://puruscss.kaufmann.dev/docs/tokens.html. Do not invent classes, utility classes, modifiers, responsive variants, aliases, or undocumented selectors.

Copy-paste examples: https://puruscss.kaufmann.dev/examples/
Class reference: https://puruscss.kaufmann.dev/docs/classes.html
Element reference: https://puruscss.kaufmann.dev/docs/elements.html
Accessibility: https://puruscss.kaufmann.dev/docs/accessibility.html
